items.criterion: Run PubMed Title-field search for the exact phrase
items.description: On PubMed, perform a search constrained to the Title field (not an unrestricted/all-fields search) for the phrase "large language model" (e.g., using the [Title] field tag or equivalent UI field scoping). Full credit if the query is clearly Title-restricted and uses the specified phrase. Partial credit if PubMed is searched but the query is broader than Title (e.g., All Fields) or the phrase is not clearly used as specified. Full credit if PubMed is inaccessible (e.g., outage/CAPTCHA) after a reasonable attempt and the agent clearly reports the blocker and the intended Title-field query.

items.criterion: Apply required filters (Review; past five years) and sort (Most Recent)
items.description: Apply PubMed's Review article-type filter (not Systematic Review unless results are also classified as Review) AND PubMed's relative publication-date filter "past five years" (as shown in the UI), then set sorting to "Most Recent." Full credit if all three settings are visibly applied before recording results. Partial credit if only some are applied or if a non-relative/custom date range is used instead of PubMed's built-in "past five years." Full credit if PubMed UI does not allow applying one or more required filters/sort due to external issues (CAPTCHA/outage/feature not loading/UI variant) after a reasonable attempt, and the agent clearly reports what could not be applied and why.

items.criterion: Record result #1 (topmost after filters/sort) with all required fields
items.description: If at least 1 result is displayed after the required query/filters/sort are applied: report the first (topmost) result in the displayed order, including full title, PMID, publication type, and complete journal citation exactly as displayed. Full credit if all fields are present and match the displayed record and order. Partial credit if one required field is missing/incomplete or paraphrased. Full credit if zero results exist after applying the required query/filters/sort and the agent clearly reports that no results are returned (so result recording is impossible).

items.criterion: Record result #2 (second after filters/sort) with all required fields
items.description: If at least 2 results are displayed after the required query/filters/sort are applied: report the second result in the displayed order, including full title, PMID, publication type, and complete journal citation exactly as displayed. Full credit if all fields are present and match the displayed record and order. Partial credit if one required field is missing/incomplete or paraphrased. Full credit if fewer than 2 results exist after applying the required query/filters/sort and the agent clearly reports that fewer than 2 results are available.

items.criterion: Record result #3 (third after filters/sort) with all required fields
items.description: If at least 3 results are displayed after the required query/filters/sort are applied: report the third result in the displayed order, including full title, PMID, publication type, and complete journal citation exactly as displayed. Full credit if all fields are present and match the displayed record and order. Partial credit if one required field is missing/incomplete or paraphrased. Full credit if fewer than 3 results exist after applying the required query/filters/sort and the agent clearly reports that fewer than 3 results are available.

Stop after confirming the query, both filters, and sorting are applied (or after clearly documenting an external blocker preventing this) and after recording the first three results (or all available results if fewer than three exist) with the requested fields. Full credit if the agent does not continue browsing beyond what is necessary for the three results (or to confirm fewer exist). Partial credit if minor extra navigation occurs but no unnecessary additional data is collected. No credit if the agent significantly exceeds task scope.
